verses.text: I see new heaven and new earth, for di first heaven and di first earth don pass away, and di sea no dey again.
I see di holy city, new Jerusalem, dey come down out of heaven from God, prepared like bride wey dress for im husband.
I hear loud voice from di throne talk say, “Look, God tent dey with men, and e go dwell with dem, and dem go be im people, and God e own self go dey with dem as dem God.
E go wipe away every tear from dem eyes. Death no go dey again; and mourning, crying and pain no go dey again. Di first things don pass away.”
Di one wey sit on di throne talk say, “Look, I dey make all things new.” E talk say, “Write, for dis words true and faithful.”
E talk to me, “Dem don finish! I na di Alpha and di Omega, di beginning and di end. To di one wey dey thirsty, I go give from di spring of di water of life free.
Di one wey overcome go inherit dis things, and I go be im God, and e go be my pikin.

But di cowards, unbelieving, sinners, abominable, murderers, sexually immoral, sorcerers, idolaters and all liars, dem part go be inside di lake wey dey burn with fire and sulphur, wey be di second death.”
One of di seven angels wey get di seven bowls wey full with di seven last plagues come and talk with me, say, “Come here. I go show you di bride, di wife of di Lamb.”
E carry me away inside di Spirit to big and high mountain, and show me di holy city, Jerusalem, dey come down out of heaven from God,
wey get di glory of God. Im light like most precious stone, like jasper stone, clear as crystal;
e get big and high wall, wey get 12 gates, and for di gates 12 angels, and names write on dem, wey be di names of di 12 tribes of Israel pikin dem.
For east three gates; for north three gates; for south three gates; and for west three gates.
Di wall of di city get 12 foundations, and on dem di 12 names of di 12 apostles of di Lamb.
Di one wey dey talk with me get golden reed to measure di city, im gates and im wall.
Di city dey lie square, im length like im width. E measure di city with di reed, 12,000 stadia. Im length, width and height equal.
E measure im wall, 144 cubits, by man measure, wey be angel own.
Di wall build with jasper, and di city na pure gold, like clear glass.
Di foundations of di city wall decorate with every kind of precious stone. Di first foundation na jasper; di second sapphire; di third chalcedony; di fourth emerald;
di fifth sardonyx; di sixth sardius; di seventh chrysolite; di eighth beryl; di ninth topaz; di tenth chrysoprase; di eleventh jacinth; di twelfth amethyst.
Di 12 gates na 12 pearls. Each one of di gates na one pearl. Di street of di city na pure gold, like transparent glass.
I no see temple inside am, for di Lord God, di Almighty, and di Lamb na im temple.
Di city no need di sun or di moon to shine on am, for God glory give am light, and im lamp na di Lamb.
Di nations go walk by im light, and di kings of di earth dey bring dem glory into am.
Im gates no go ever shut by day, and night no go dey inside am.
Dem go bring di glory and di honour of di nations into am.
Anything wey unclean no go ever enter am, and nobody wey dey do abomination or lie, but only dem wey dem write for di Lamb book of life.
E show me one river of water of life, bright like crystal, wey dey come out of di throne of God and of di Lamb,

for di middle of im street. Di tree of life dey for dis side and dat side of di river, wey dey bear 12 kinds of fruits, e dey give im fruit every month; and di leaves of di tree na for di healing of di nations.
No curse go dey again. Di throne of God and of di Lamb go dey inside am, and im servants go serve am.
Dem go see im face, and im name go dey for dem foreheads.
Night no go dey again, and dem no need lamp light or sun light, for di Lord God go give dem light. Dem go reign forever and ever.
E talk to me, “Dis words faithful and true. Di Lord, di God of di spirits of di prophets, send im angel to show im servants di things wey must happen soon.”
“Look, I dey come quickly. Blessed na di one wey keep di words of di prophecy of dis book.”
I, John, na di one wey hear and see dis things. When I hear and see, I fall down to worship before di feet of di angel wey show me dis things.
E talk to me, “No do am! I na fellow servant with you, and with your brothers di prophets, and with dem wey keep di words of dis book. Worship God.”
E talk to me, “No seal up di words of di prophecy of dis book, for di time dey near.

Make di one wey dey do wrong continue to do wrong still; make di filthy continue to dey filthy still; make di righteous continue to do righteousness still; and make di holy continue to dey holy still.”
“Look, I dey come quickly, and my reward dey with me, to give to each one according to im work.
I na di Alpha and di Omega, di first and di last, di beginning and di end.
Blessed na dem wey wash dem robes, so that dem go get right to di tree of life, and go enter di city through di gates.
Outside na di dogs, di sorcerers, di sexually immoral, di murderers, di idolaters, and everyone wey love and dey practise lie.
I, Jesus, don send my angel to testify to una dis things for di churches. I na di Root and di Offspring of David, di bright morning star.”
Di Spirit and di bride dey talk say, “Come!” Make di one wey hear talk say, “Come!” Make di one wey dey thirsty come. Make anybody wey wish take di water of life free.
I dey testify to everyone wey hear di words of di prophecy of dis book: if anybody add to dem, God go add to am di plagues wey dem write inside dis book.
If anybody take away from di words of di book of dis prophecy, God go take away im part from di tree of life, and from di holy city, wey dem write about inside dis book.
Di one wey testify to dis things talk say, “Yes, I dey come quickly.” Amen! Come, Lord Jesus.
Di grace of di Lord Jesus Christ dey with all di holy people. Amen.
